description.text: The first Neo set and the first with Pokémon from Johto, released in December 2000 with 111 cards and two theme decks, Cold Fusion and HotFoot. It added the Darkness and Metal types, each powered by a Special Energy, Baby Pokémon, which evolve and make an attacker flip a coin before attacking them, and Pokémon Tool cards. Its card design moved closer to the Japanese one, with smaller black HP. Sneasel and Slowking were later banned from tournaments, and the art of Moo-Moo Milk, Arcade Game and Card-Flip Game was redrawn for English.
